name: yew
enchant_note: The churchyard tree, the tree of death and rebirth, holds a charm.
protection_note: A shield's yew: held, not worn, so it guards with its AC alone.
lore_descriptor: tight-grained and red at the heart, the wood of longbows and churchyards
first_pickup_chronicle: Found a yew shield from a churchyard tree. The fey will not touch it.
